mapper.select: SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, DATE_FORMAT(BRD.B_DATE, '%y-%m-%d') AS B_DATE FROM BOARD BRD INNER JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX ORDER BY BRD.B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_IDX < #{lastBIdx} ORDER BY BRD.B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX WHERE BRD.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
SELECT IMG.I_IDX AS I_IDX, IMG.I_B_IDX AS I_B_IDX, IMG.I_IMAGE AS I_IMAGE FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN IMAGE_FILE IMG ON IMG.I_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (B_U_IDX, B_TITLE, B_CONTENT) VALUES (#{b_u_idx}, #{b_title}, #{b_content})
